WITH paper AS (
SELECT id,market_ticker,status,created_at FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
), live AS (
SELECT f.id,f.market_ticker,f.filled_at FROM fills f
JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'
)
SELECT 'source_role' AS metric,current_user::text AS value
UNION ALL SELECT 'source_role_elevated',(rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls)::text FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname=current_user
UNION ALL SELECT 'bot_readonly_exists',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='bot_readonly')::text
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_rows',count(*)::text FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_closed_rows',count(*)::text FROM paper WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl')
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_series',count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1))::text FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_min_id',min(id)::text FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_max_id',max(id)::text FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_first_at',min(created_at)::text FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_last_at',max(created_at)::text FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_fill_rows',count(*)::text FROM live
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_series',count(DISTINCT split_part(market_ticker,'-',1))::text FROM live
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_min_id',min(id)::text FROM live
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_max_id',max(id)::text FROM live
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_first_at',min(filled_at)::text FROM live
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_last_at',max(filled_at)::text FROM live
